I found some issue after testing GLM 0.9.5 with CUDA 6 rc. 

I could include <glm/glm.hpp> and <glm/ext.hpp> which I don't recommand to do for compilation time reason but it's now successful. 

Onlye GLM_GTX_string_cast is not support with CUDA so that if it is explicitly included, GLM will generated the error message "GLM_GTX_string_cast is not supported on CUDA compiler".
